minPosNote: Damper output is 2-10 Vdc: 2 V = closed, 10 V = full open (Table 5 DAMPER OUT range 2.0-10.0 V). Damper % ≈ (V - 2) / 8 x 100. Actual OA airflow % is not linear with blade position: verify minimum OA with a temperature-fraction or airflow measurement.

alarmCatalog.MA T SENS ERR: Mixed air sensor failed or disconnected. Check wiring, then replace the sensor.
alarmCatalog.CO2 SENS ERR: CO2 sensor failed, out of range, or disconnected.
alarmCatalog.OA SYLK T ERR: OA Sylk sensor temperature failed or disconnected.
alarmCatalog.OA SYLK H ERR: OA Sylk sensor humidity failed or disconnected.
alarmCatalog.RA SYLK T ERR: RA Sylk sensor temperature failed or disconnected.
alarmCatalog.RA SYLK H ERR: RA Sylk sensor humidity failed or disconnected.
alarmCatalog.DA SYLK T ERR: Discharge air Sylk sensor failed or disconnected.
alarmCatalog.OA SENS T ERR: 20k OA temperature sensor failed or disconnected.
alarmCatalog.ACT ERROR: Actuator failed or disconnected: check stall, supply voltage and count. Replace if the damper moves freely and supply is 21.6-26.4 V.
alarmCatalog.FREEZE ALARM: OA below LOW T LOCK or MAT below MA LO SET. Clears when conditions return to normal.
alarmCatalog.SHUTDOWN ACTIVE: AUX2 IN set to shutdown and 24 V applied.
alarmCatalog.DMP CAL RUNNING: DCV auto damper calibration in progress.
alarmCatalog.DA SENS ALM: Discharge air outside the DA LO/HI ALM range.
alarmCatalog.SYS ALARM: AUX1 OUT = SYS and an alarm is active: 24 Vac on AUX1-O.
alarmCatalog.ACT UNDER V: Actuator supply voltage out of range (low).
alarmCatalog.ACT OVER V: Actuator supply voltage out of range (high).
alarmCatalog.ACT STALLED: Actuator stopped before reaching the commanded position.

pcModToolOnly.ACTUATOR SLIPPAGE ALARM: Default ENABLED. JADE checks for the expected air-temperature change when the damper moves; if it doesn't happen, it alarms that the actuator has slipped or disconnected from the damper. Sensitivity LOW (default) = 20 checks before alarm, STANDARD = 10, HIGH = 5.
pcModToolOnly.LOCATION OF ECONOMIZER CONTROL SENSOR: Default before the cooling coil; AUTO if the MAT sensor sits after the coil.

setupMode: For the first 60 minutes after power-up the JADE is in setup mode: a missing OA or Sylk device won't alarm, but the MA sensor is critical and will. After 60 minutes, any removed or failed component alarms.

strategyBySensors.note: JADE detects sensors by polling (p.1). Differential dry bulb needs a 20k sensor on OA plus a Sylk sensor in the RA with its DIP switch set to RA (p.2).
differential dry bulb: C7400S Sylk in RA (DIP switch = RA)
